sources.title: Fossen's Marine Craft Model
sources.evidence: Official author webpage, mathematical formulation and kinematics read on retrieval date
sources.use: Boundary comparison only: full marine dynamics include inertia, Coriolis, damping and restoring terms; this repository does not identify or implement those terms for a real vehicle.

model_provenance: Own fully actuated planar world-frame acceleration surrogate and constrained feedforward+PID implementation. Gains, actuation limits, noise/drift strengths are explicit engineering settings, not fitted vessel parameters or original-thesis MPC. No third-party control code copied.
